list.title: Your conversations, grouped by contact
list.body: One entry = one person. See every message from them, across all accounts.

filters.title: Humans or noise?
filters.body: One tap filters out real conversations from newsletters and automated notifications.

swipe.title: Swipe to act
swipe.body: Swipe right to archive, left to mark unread. Two thresholds based on distance.

composer.title: Write, send
composer.body: The composer expands as you type. Drafts auto-save every 2 s.

search.title: Search anywhere, fast
search.body: Full-text search across all accounts. Under 300 ms on 10,000 messages.

nps.title: How likely are you to recommend PLI?
nps.subtitle: 0 = not at all · 10 = extremely

prompt.detractor: What's keeping you from recommending us today?

feedback.title: Anything to flag?
feedback.placeholder: Tell us what you saw, or what you wish you'd seen…
feedback.thanks: Got it, thanks. We'll reply within 24 h.

waitlist.title: Join the private beta
waitlist.subtitle: 100 spots. Batched invites. Free during beta.
waitlist.motivation_placeholder: Why PLI? What do you run? (optional, 280 chars max)
waitlist.privacy: Your email is only used to send you an invite code and PLI news. One-click unsubscribe.
waitlist.sent: Check your inbox — we sent you a confirmation link.
waitlist.error_generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a few minutes.

invited.title: You're invited
invited.subtitle: Confirm your code: {{code}}
invited.missing_code: No code found. Check the link in your email.
